info.title: Ablo Sync Engine HTTP API
info.description:
The HTTP surface of the Ablo sync engine. Most production traffic flows over WebSocket via `@abloatai/ablo`; this HTTP API is the Vercel-safe transport for environments that cannot hold long-lived sockets, plus the control plane for capabilities and usage.

The per-model resource routes (`/v1/models/{model}`) are **generated from your own pushed schema** — they are documented here generically over `{model}`, with `tasks` as the running example. Authenticate every request with a `Bearer` API key or scoped token.

tags.name: Records
tags.description: Typed CRUD over any model in your schema.

tags.name: Coordination
tags.description: Claims — pessimistic row reservation for human+agent coordination.

post.description: Submit a batch of typed mutations. Atomic: if any operation is denied or fails, the entire commit is rejected. Successful commits broadcast a typed `SyncDelta` to every co-present peer.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Replay-safe identifier; derive it from the business event, not a random value. Same key + same body returns the same receipt.

reads.description: Batch-level read dependencies. If a premise moved, its `onStale` policy applies to the whole batch.

post.description: Mint a scoped, short-lived token (e.g. for an agent) from a secret key.

403.description: The presented key cannot mint this scope.

404.description: No such capability.
No such capability.

readAt.description: Watermark from when the caller reasoned about the target. The server detects writes since this id and applies `onStale`. SDK-managed; leave unset for last-writer-wins.

onStale.description: Conflict policy when `readAt` is stale: reject the commit, overwrite the newer value, or commit and return a notification.

queue.description: Join the FIFO queue when another participant holds the row.
